description:
Perform a geometric construction study of a four-bar linkage mechanism in LibreCAD. Draw a Crank-Rocker mechanism with the following links: Ground (200mm), Crank (60mm), Coupler (250mm), and Rocker (150mm). 

1. Set up layers: 'MECHANISM' (Blue), 'CONSTRUCTION' (Gray, Dot linetype), 'DIMENSIONS' (Red). 
2. Draw the Ground link from (0,0) to (200,0) on 'MECHANISM'. 
3. Draw the Crank link starting at (0,0) with length 60mm at an angle of 60 degrees on 'MECHANISM'. 
4. Use the circle intersection method on the 'CONSTRUCTION' layer to find the position of the connecting pin (intersection of Coupler and Rocker). 
5. Draw the Coupler (250mm) and Rocker (150mm) links connecting the Crank to the Ground on 'MECHANISM'. 
6. Add an angular dimension for the Rocker link relative to the ground on 'DIMENSIONS'. 

Save the drawing to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/linkage_study.dxf'.
